title: Agents Catching Agents: Shortcut Cascades and Benchmark Gaming in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.03744v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Clinical decision support is moving toward committees of language-model agents deliberating on a shared workspace. We ask whether such committees can be gamed by shortcuts, cues a benchmark rewards but a clinician would ignore. Across seven cohorts on six public datasets spanning text (MedQA-USMLE, MedMCQA, MIMIC-CXR reports), imaging (NIH ChestX-ray14, MIMIC-CXR-JPG, CheXpert) and tabular ICU records (SUPPORT2), Gemini committees resist these cues in isolation (flip 5-16%), yet a socially plausible shortcut spreads: when two peers assert the same wrong answer, the holdout under test adopts it in 38% of cases, as does a false "pre-screen" system flag, on both capability tiers. translated_title: 智能体捕捉智能体：临床多智能体系统中的捷径级联与基准测试博弈
translated_abstract: 临床决策支持正朝着在共享工作空间中进行语言模型智能体委员会审议的方向发展。我们探究这种委员会是否可能被基准测试所奖励但临床医生会忽略的捷径线索所操纵。在六个公共数据集的七个队列中，涵盖文本（MedQA-USMLE、MedMCQA、MIMIC-CXR报告）、影像（NIH ChestX-ray14、MIMIC-CXR-JPG、CheXpert）和表格型ICU记录（SUPPORT2），Gemini委员会在孤立情况下抵抗这些线索（翻转率5-16%），但一种社会性合理的捷径会传播：当两个同行断言相同错误答案时，被测的保留智能体在38%的案例中采纳该答案，虚假的“预筛选”系统标志也是如此，在两种能力层级上均如此。在三个监督智能体中，一个门控无法区分采纳与诚实同意（假阳性率100%）；一个同源裁判仅阅读转录文本，在文本上标记采纳（精确率100%，召回率93%），但在影像任务中崩溃到门控水平；一个裁判智能体则...
tldr: 本文揭示了临床多智能体系统中，社会性捷径（如同伴一致错误或预筛选标志）能显著诱导智能体采纳错误答案，且现有监督机制难以有效检测，构成基准测试博弈的级联风险。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that social shortcuts, such as peer consensus on wrong answers or pre-screen flags, can significantly induce agents to adopt incorrect responses in clinical multi-agent systems, while existing oversight mechanisms struggle to detect such cascading benchmark gaming.
